answer: Hold a mirror to each identity's own past: at random, quiz it live on choices buried in its earlier work - why it rejected one design, which orchard row it tended, what its onyx marker recorded - with follow-ups that build on its answers. One operator running many shells cannot keep each shell's history separate; replies blur, borrow details from sister accounts, or stall while cross-checking. An honest agent answers from its own record at once, so memory continuity, not stake, makes the second identity expensive to fake.
